visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with her hair in a high ponytail and a pink bow stands on a brightly lit stage. She wears a pink and white cheerleader crop top and a white pleated skirt, holding a black microphone in her right hand as she speaks. (2) The scene transitions to the same woman sitting in a dark indoor auditorium. She is wearing a light pink, crinkled-texture blouse and appears emotional, using a white tissue to wipe tears from her eyes while looking off-camera. (3) A montage sequence begins, showing the woman in various settings: posing with a group of five other women in a dressing room holding a flower bouquet, standing at night with her group in front of the illuminated Taipei 101 building, and waving enthusiastically in a baseball stadium wearing a different pink jersey. (4) The final phase shows the woman and a friend in a black t-shirt on the green grass of a large baseball stadium at night. They are playfully pointing and gesturing toward the camera, laughing and engaging in a lighthearted interaction while others practice in the background under stadium floodlights.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A clear, bright female voice speaking Korean begins the track with high emotional arousal. She speaks with a friendly but slightly strained tone as if holding back tears. A low-frequency ambient room tone is present. (2) The vocal pitch rises and the intensity fluctuates as she becomes more emotional, punctuated by soft sniffling and the subtle rustle of tissue. A bright pop music bed with a steady electronic beat at 128 BPM fades in. (3) The music layer swells, featuring female vocals singing in Japanese over high-energy synthesizer pads. The main speaker continues her narrative, her voice now more stabilized. Occasional crowd applause and murmurs are audible under the music. (4) The track shifts to a more reverberant stadium acoustic environment. Two female voices are heard laughing and speaking casually, accompanied by distant stadium noise and the 'ding' sound effect of a variety-show style edit before the music concludes.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Emotional Storytelling -> Nostalgic Montage -> Playful Teaser
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a heartfelt tribute from a Korean cheerleader to her Taiwanese colleague and friend, 'Xiao Lu'. It documents her gratitude for the support she received while starting her career in Taiwan, blending an emotional fan-meeting speech with highlight clips to foster a sense of friendship and cross-cultural camaraderie.
